terbaru.pelajaran: We propose a security reference architecture to support standardized vulnerability and threat analysis.

terbaru.pelajaran: This paper proposes Proof of Success and Reward Distribution (PSCRD), a novel multi-bridge response coordination and incentive distribution protocol designed to address the challenges.

terbaru.judul: D2M: A Decentralized, Privacy-Preserving, Incentive-Compatible Data Marketplace for Collaborative Learning
terbaru.pelajaran: We present \prot, a decentralized data marketplace that unifies federated learning, blockchain arbitration, and economic incentives into a single framework for privacy-preserving data sharing.

terbaru.judul: An Explainable AI Model for the Detecting Malicious Smart Contracts Based on EVM Opcode Based Features
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we propose an ML based malicious smart contract detection mechanism by analyzing the EVM opcodes.

terbaru.judul: The Memecoin Phenomenon: An In-Depth Study of Solana's Blockchain Trends

terbaru.judul: CCN: Decentralized Cross-Chain Channel Networks Supporting Secure and Privacy-Preserving Multi-Hop Interactions
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we propose the Cross-Chain Channel Network (CCN), a decentralized network designed to support secure and privacy-preserving multi-hop cross-chain transactions.

terbaru.judul: Leveraging Large Language Models to Bridge Cross-Domain Transparency in Stablecoins
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce a large language model (LLM)-based automated framework for bridging cross-domain transparency in stablecoins by aligning issuer disclosures with observable circulation evidence.

terbaru.judul: Decentralized Multi-Agent System with Trust-Aware Communication
